Identified 5, 7, and 13 as odd using pairing examples.
Identified 4 and 6 as even because all objects can form pairs.
Used an incorrect rule that an odd final digit always leaves one unpaired.

At home, use small groups of objects to pair 13 items and count the pairs and leftover items together.
